end.summary:
Reyansh showed understanding of top, front and side views on why and new-situation questions.
They practised explaining why views change from different places; this still needs checking for consistency.
They practised matching views to objects; this still needs checking.
They practised noticing that a view can hide parts of an object, but the same-view-from-every-side mix-up remained at the end.
end.parentNote: Asha practised top, front and side views with Reyansh using a ball, cylinder, cup and birthday cap. They used the visible outline in several examples, but still mixed up what another person can see and sometimes included hidden parts; this was not corrected by the last example. At home, place a cup or toy in different positions and ask, “What can this person see from here?” before drawing only the visible shape.
